description: This line plot, titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny," illustrates the change in Word Error Rate (WER) across six epochs for five different fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper model. The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at integer intervals. The y-axis represents WER, ranging from 30 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot displays five distinct lines: "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" (solid line with circle markers), "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" (solid line with square markers), "tiny int4" (dashed line with circle markers), "tiny int8" (dashed line with square markers), and "tiny full" (dotted line with triangle markers). All lines show a general downward trend in WER as epochs increase. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" line starts at a WER of 69.5 at epoch 0 and decreases to 32.5 at epoch 6. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" line begins at 60.0 at epoch 0 and ends at 35.5 at epoch 6. The "tiny int4" line starts at 60.0 at epoch 0 and ends at 39.5 at epoch 6. The "tiny int8" line begins at 59.5 at epoch 0 and ends at 35.5 at epoch 6. The "tiny full" line starts at 29.5 at epoch 0 and ends at 24.5 at epoch 6, showing the lowest WER throughout the training process.
